Your own model lab.

Train a real Multinomial Naive Bayes classifier on your labeled news.

Bring your dataset

Upload a UTF-8 CSV with text,label columns. Labels must be real or fake. Use at least 10 unique articles per class. Maximum 2 MB and 5,000 rows.

The example illustrates the file format only; it is too small to train a useful model.

No model trained. The analyzer currently uses transparent language rules.

Know what you're measuring

Evaluation will appear here after training.

How it works

  1. Normalize and tokenize article text.
  2. Remove duplicate articles and split each class: 80% train / 20% test.
  3. Learn word frequencies with Laplace smoothing.
  4. Evaluate on held-out articles, then use that model for predictions.

A model learns patterns in your dataset, including bias. Test accuracy is not real-world truth accuracy. No web search or external fact checking is performed. Language rules target English; custom training supports Unicode word tokens.
